summary: Zentek Ltd., a TSXV/OTCQX-listed Canadian graphene technology company, filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report on Form 8-K) disclosing team changes effective October 2026: Angela Lomets joins October 14 as non-executive VP Commercialization–ZenGUARD, and Morgan Knowles was engaged October 1 for investor relations and capital markets communications. Senior VP Strategy and Business Development Ryan Shacklock departs effective October 5, 2026, with CEO Mohammed Jiwan thanking him and citing transformation progress, ZenGUARD regulatory clearance, and a filed preliminary economic assessment. No financial terms, stake, price, premium, advisors, or regulatory clocks were disclosed. Watch for succession gaps in strategy/business development and whether IR hires precede financing or capital-strategy announcements.
